profile.ja:
強い野心を持ち幹部の座を狙うノマドの戦士、その若き日の姿。
没落した貴族の出自で、その再興のために幹部になることを目標として掲げている。
怒りや憎しみ、痛みによって絶大な力を得る特異な能力「ベルセルク」を持つ。
心身ともに苦痛への耐性が高く、あえて敵に囚われることで能力を発動させ、敵勢力内部から打撃を与えるといった苛烈な作戦を得意とする。
だが、それはあくまで現在の話。若かりし頃の彼女はまだそこまでの精神的な強靭さは得ておらず、己の能力を使うことに躊躇いもある。
ある時、そんな彼女は悪意ある者たちに捕らわれ……。
profile.en: She is a young nomad warrior with a strong ambition to become a high-ranking officer, hailing from a fallen noble family. Her goal is to restore her family's honor, and she possesses the unique ability "Berserk," which grants her immense power through anger, hatred, and pain. She is highly resilient, both physically and mentally, and excels in brutal operations that involve deliberately allowing herself to be captured by the enemy, thereby unleashing her abilities and striking from within. However, this is her current state; in her younger years, she lacked the mental fortitude to fully utilize her abilities and was more hesitant to do so. At one point, she was captured by malicious individuals...

text.ja: 私は戦士のアレクトラ。今は流浪の身だが、没落した我が家を必ず再興すると誓っている。あなたも協力してくれるか、隊長
text.en: I am Alectra, a warrior. Currently, I'm a nomad, but I've sworn to restore my fallen family. Will you help me, Captain?

text.ja: 気高き父、優しき母……家族と共に過ごした日々は私の誇りだ。それを取り戻すため、私は命を賭けて戦う……！
text.en: My noble father, my kind mother... the days I spent with my family are my pride. I'll risk my life to reclaim that pride and fight for it.

text.ja: 私の中に秘められた力……使うのは正直をいえば恐ろしい。だが、我が願いのためには躊躇ってはいられない
text.en: The power hidden within me... to be honest, it's terrifying to use. But for my desires, I won't hesitate.

text.ja: 復讐……そして確かな地位を得ること、それが私の願い。俗物と笑えば笑え！　最後に笑うのはこの私だ！
text.en: Revenge, and gaining a solid position - those are my desires. You can mock me as a materialistic person, but I'll have the last laugh!

text.ja: 隊長、あなたはなかなかの強者のようだ。あなたのような人物が我が家の復興に手を貸してくれると心強い
text.en: Captain, you seem like a formidable person. It's reassuring to have someone like you helping me restore my family's honor.

text.ja: 手柄を立てるためなら、どんな困難な任務でも果たして見せる！　私の心に迷いはないぞ
text.en: I'll take on any difficult mission to achieve my goals! My mind is made up, and I won't waver.

text.ja: 『被虐趣味』、『敗北者』……そう私を嘲る者もいる。だが構わない。私にはわかってくれる人もいる。隊長、あなたのようにな
text.en: Some people mock me, calling me a "loser" or saying I have a "masochistic hobby." But that's fine. There are people who understand me, like you, Captain.

text.ja: この隊に所属したのは出世の足がかりを掴むためで、慣れ合うつもりはない。いや、そのはずだったが……不思議と、この場所は居心地が良いな
text.en: I joined this unit to use it as a stepping stone for my advancement, and I didn't plan on getting too close to anyone. But somehow, this place feels comfortable.

text.ja: ふくぅうぅうぅ……わ、笑わせるなぁ……！　貴様ら下賤のチンポにいくら突かれようと、わたしは少しも……んぅっ！？　あひっ、やめろぉっ！
text.en: Hah hah hah... you think you can make me laugh? You fools, with your pathetic... Ah, no! Even if you penetrate me as much as you want, I won't... Ah, stop it!

text.ja: しょ、触手だとぉ……！？　そんなものを入れるとは……あぁ、貴様ら全員、必ずころ……ひぐぅっ！？　あぁぁぁあぁっ！！
text.en: Ugh, tentacles...!? You're going to put those things inside me...!? Ah, you'll all pay for this... huuuh!? Aaaaaahhh!!

text.ja: おぉおぉ、母乳でりゅ、おっぱいピューピュー止まらにゃ……ひぃいぃぃいっ！　イグうぅうぅううううっ！
text.en: Oh no, oh no, it's milking time, my breasts are going to burst... hiiiii! Uuuuuuuuuuhhh!
